name: oh-my-lsp
description: Use oh-my-lsp CLI to navigate code and refactor safely via LSP and AST-grep. Use when a user asks to go to definition, find references, find all usages of a function/method/variable, list symbols in a file, check type errors or diagnostics, rename a symbol across the codebase, search for structural code patterns, or bulk-replace code patterns with AST-aware rewrites.
